label: MEET LITERATE
title: Your reading,
out loud.
body: Articles, selected text, and local PDFs.

label: 01 / VOICES
title: Two ways
to listen.
body: Instant uses installed device voices. Natural uses Kokoro, with model files cached after the first download.
note: Speech is generated on your device.

label: 02 / READING
title: Articles.
Selected text.
body: The main text can play with word highlighting. Selected passages have the Read selection aloud option.

label: 03 / READING AREA
title: A focused
reading area.
body: Choose section focuses the reader on a particular part of the page.
note: Sidebars and related stories can stay outside the reading area.

label: 04 / MINI-PLAYER
title: Text that
stays nearby.
body: The mini-player keeps text nearby, with clickable words and an option to stay above other windows.
note: Pin support varies by browser. The original page remains open.

label: 05 / APPEARANCE
title: Your pace.
Your appearance.
body: Playback speed, light and dark modes, and accent colors are adjustable.

label: 06 / LOCAL PDFS
title: Local PDFs,
with a voice.
body: Local PDFs are supported with Chrome’s Allow access to file URLs permission.
note: Scanned PDFs need text recognition first.

label: LISTENING, LOCALLY
title: Private listening.
Your own pace.
body: Speech runs on your device. Kokoro’s files download from Hugging Face.
note: The source page stays open while the mini-player is in use.
